nodes.summary: k-automatic and k-regular sequences, Cobham's theorem and kernels, meta-automatic sequences, results proved with the Walnut prover, and numeration systems (Dumont–Thomas, Tribonacci and Zeckendorf representations) whose digit words define such sequences.
nodes.title: Automatic sequences and numeration systems

nodes.summary: Properties of finite words: Lyndon and primitive words, equilibrious words, Ulam words, keyword substitutions, universal cycles for subsets, capacity of Catalan words, rectangles in nondecreasing words, and intersections in pairs of words.
nodes.title: Finite words

nodes.summary: Infinite words generated by substitutions and their codings: Fibonacci, Tribonacci and Thue–Morse words and generalizations, pure morphic and morphic words, Sturmian and balanced words, factor complexity and Pansiot's classification, palindromic and relative-position properties, first differences of binary words.
nodes.title: Morphic and Sturmian words

nodes.summary: Squares, overlaps, cubes and fractional powers in words: square-free and overlap-free words, abelian and k-abelian repetitions, power-free morphisms, Crochemore's test and Dejean's repetition threshold.
nodes.title: Repetitions in words

nodes.summary: Integer sequences defined by self-reference, greedy or mex rules: Kolakoski, Gijswijt (curling numbers), Cloitre, Connell, Aronson, Smarandache, van der Laan, throwback and anti-recurrence sequences, self-generating sets, fractal sequences and inventory loops.
nodes.title: Self-describing and self-generating sequences

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
